note_for_candidate: GET /core/shifts — shift_timings is a list of shift START times in 'HH:MM' local IST, not a [start, end] pair. Each entry starts a shift that runs until the next entry; the last entry runs until the first one, crossing midnight. e.g. ['00:30','12:30'] means two shifts: 00:30-12:30 and 12:30-00:30. Do not hard-code shift names.
